blurb: Mañana Resort & Marina offers a full-service marina with slips from 38 to 80 feet, transient and contract moorage, and facilities including fuel dock and pump out. The resort includes lodging with pet-friendly suites, a restaurant, and event spaces for groups and weddings. The marina is located on Vancouver Island's protected eastern shore, near Ladysmith and transportation hubs.
